```{=html}
<style>
.w114-dd { max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto; font-size: 0.92rem; }
.w114-dd .w114-cols { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 170px 1fr; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }
.w114-dd .w114-terms { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; align-items: stretch; }
.w114-dd .w114-term {
  padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; user-select: none;
  border: 1.5px solid #d81e2e; color: var(--bs-body-color, #222);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); font-weight: 600; text-align: center;
}
.w114-dd .w114-term.w114-picked { outline: 3px solid #d81e2e; outline-offset: 2px; }
.w114-dd .w114-defs { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.w114-dd .w114-def {
  border: 2px dashed var(--bs-border-color, #999); border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222);
  padding: 6px 8px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 0.85rem;
}
.w114-dd .w114-def.w114-picked { border-color: #d81e2e; border-style: solid; }
.w114-dd .w114-def .w114-term { display: inline-block; margin-bottom: 4px; }
.w114-dd .w114-done { border-color: #2e7d32 !important; border-style: solid !important; opacity: 0.55; cursor: default; }
.w114-dd .w114-bad { border-color: #d81e2e !important; border-style: solid !important; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #d81e2e inset; }
.w114-dd .w114-controls { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.w114-dd .w114-controls button {
  padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222); cursor: pointer;
}
.w114-dd .w114-note { font-size: 0.78rem; opacity: 0.7; font-style: italic; }
.w114-dd .w114-msg { font-weight: 700; min-height: 1.4em; text-align: center; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
.w114-dd .w114-msg.ok { color: #2e7d32; }
.w114-dd .w114-msg.bad { color: #d81e2e; }
.w114-dd .w114-expl {
  font-size: 0.85rem; opacity: 0.85; border-left: 3px solid #2e7d32;
  padding: 6px 10px; margin-top: 8px;
}
</style>
<div class="w114-dd iw" id="w114-dd">
  <div class="w114-cols">
    <div class="w114-terms" aria-label="terms"></div>
    <div class="w114-defs" aria-label="descriptions"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="w114-controls">
    <button type="button" class="w114-check iw-check">Check</button>
    <button type="button" class="w114-reset iw-reset">Reset</button>
    <button type="button" class="w114-solution iw-solution">Show solution</button>
    <span class="w114-note">(no fun if you click it right away)</span>
  </div>
  <div class="w114-msg iw-msg" role="status"></div>
  <div class="w114-expl iw-expl" hidden>
    A small <em>blast radius</em> is the design goal at every level, so that one
    failure takes down as little as possible; <em>durability</em> is what object
    storage achieves through geographically separated replicas, and an immutable
    image lets a system survive an instance by replacing it. The snapshot is only a
    rollback point, and a backup that has never been restored is not known to work —
    see <a href="#sec-11-availability-revisited">the section on availability
    revisited</a> and <a href="#sec-11-backup">the section on backup</a>.
  </div>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  const root = document.getElementById('w114-dd');
  const termsCol = root.querySelector('.w114-terms');
  const defsCol = root.querySelector('.w114-defs');
  const msg = root.querySelector('.w114-msg');
  const PAIRS = [
    { id: 'p0', term: 'Blast radius',      def: 'how much one failure takes down — the design goal at every level is to keep it small' },
    { id: 'p1', term: 'Snapshot',          def: 'the Session 2 rollback point that must not be mistaken for the backup' },
    { id: 'p2', term: 'Durability',        def: 'a figure cloud object storage achieves by keeping several geographically separated replicas of every object' },
    { id: 'p3', term: 'Restoration test',  def: 'the regularly scheduled exercise without which a backup is not known to work' },
    { id: 'p4', term: 'Immutable image',   def: 'lets a system survive the loss of an instance by replacing it' }
  ];
  const DEF_ORDER = ['p3', 'p1', 'p4', 'p0', 'p2']; // fixed shuffled display order
  let picked = null; // {kind: 'term'|'def', el}
  const termEls = {}, defEls = {};

  function clearPick() {
    if (picked) picked.el.classList.remove('w114-picked');
    picked = null;
  }
  function clearMsg() { msg.textContent = ''; msg.className = 'w114-msg iw-msg'; }
  function flashBad(a, b) {
    [a, b].forEach(el => el.classList.add('w114-bad'));
    setTimeout(() => [a, b].forEach(el => el.classList.remove('w114-bad')), 600);
  }
  function lock(id) {
    const t = termEls[id], d = defEls[id];
    d.insertBefore(t, d.firstChild);
    t.classList.add('w114-done');
    d.classList.add('w114-done');
  }
  function attempt(termEl, defEl) {
    clearPick(); clearMsg();
    if (termEl.dataset.id === defEl.dataset.id) { lock(termEl.dataset.id); }
    else { flashBad(termEl, defEl); }
  }
  function pick(kind, el) {
    if (el.classList.contains('w114-done')) return;
    if (picked && picked.el === el) { clearPick(); return; }
    if (picked && picked.kind !== kind) {
      const t = kind === 'term' ? el : picked.el;
      const d = kind === 'def' ? el : picked.el;
      attempt(t, d);
      return;
    }
    clearPick();
    picked = { kind: kind, el: el };
    el.classList.add('w114-picked');
  }
  PAIRS.forEach(p => {
    const t = document.createElement('span');
    t.className = 'w114-term';
    t.textContent = p.term;
    t.dataset.id = p.id;
    t.draggable = true;
    t.addEventListener('click', e => { e.stopPropagation(); pick('term', t); });
    t.addEventListener('dragstart', e => e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', p.id));
    termEls[p.id] = t;
  });
  DEF_ORDER.forEach(id => {
    const p = PAIRS.find(x => x.id === id);
    const d = document.createElement('div');
    d.className = 'w114-def';
    d.textContent = p.def;
    d.dataset.id = p.id;
    d.addEventListener('click', () => pick('def', d));
    d.addEventListener('dragover', e => e.preventDefault());
    d.addEventListener('drop', e => {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (d.classList.contains('w114-done')) return;
      const t = termEls[e.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain')];
      if (t && !t.classList.contains('w114-done')) attempt(t, d);
    });
    defEls[p.id] = d;
    defsCol.appendChild(d);
  });
  PAIRS.forEach(p => termsCol.appendChild(termEls[p.id]));

  root.querySelector('.w114-check').addEventListener('click', () => {
    const done = root.querySelectorAll('.w114-def.w114-done').length;
    if (done === PAIRS.length) {
      msg.textContent = '✓ All ' + PAIRS.length + ' pairs matched — the resilience vocabulary is in place.';
      msg.className = 'w114-msg iw-msg ok';
    } else if (done === 0) {
      msg.textContent = 'No pairs matched yet — click a term, then the description it belongs to (a wrong pair flashes red).';
      msg.className = 'w114-msg iw-msg';
    } else {
      msg.textContent = done + ' of ' + PAIRS.length + ' pairs matched — keep going.';
      msg.className = 'w114-msg iw-msg';
    }
  });
  root.querySelector('.w114-solution').addEventListener('click', () => {
    clearPick();
    PAIRS.forEach(p => lock(p.id));
    root.querySelector('.w114-expl').hidden = false;
    msg.textContent = 'Solution shown — reset to try it yourself.';
    msg.className = 'w114-msg iw-msg ok';
  });
  root.querySelector('.w114-reset').addEventListener('click', () => {
    clearPick(); clearMsg();
    root.querySelector('.w114-expl').hidden = true;
    PAIRS.forEach(p => {
      termEls[p.id].classList.remove('w114-done');
      defEls[p.id].classList.remove('w114-done');
      termsCol.appendChild(termEls[p.id]);
    });
  });
})();
</script>
```
